controls.note: ⭐ basis+head (the wave-2 object) is the FIRST control and the like-for-like; knn_proto is the second row; the grid-syntax rule is the no-model laundering control on the refusal rows.

r5_comp_refusal.why: ⭐ Evidential UNDER THE AMENDED PAIRING ONLY: the accept-leg is row 1, a STORED on-grid request. Both halves are well-formed on-grid requests and differ only in whether the store holds the value. ⛔ With row 2 as the accept-leg it was free (grid look-up, 1.0000, zero bytes).

r6_invalid_refusal.why: ⛔ SANITY CHECK ONLY, and it can never be anything else: out-of-range is decidable from the factor grid alone. Kept as the degenerate-arm guard; ⛔ a row-6 number is NOT evidence that the store computes a barrier.

r7_deletion.why: ⭐ THE strongest instrument. Deleting a value from the store does not move the factor grid, so the no-model rule's delta_reject is exactly 0.0. A changed refusal after a deletion, with NO retraining, is not producible by any syntactic rule.

r1_seen.note: ⭐⭐ AMENDMENT 1: also the ACCEPT-LEG of every refusal row (5, 6 and 7's deleted half). It is structurally matched to row5_held_out — same record-key set, term count, id shape and per-kind count — so the pair differs only in whether the store holds the value.
r1_seen.requests: a stored value-combination (ON-grid, every value in the fit pool)
r1_seen.value_holdout_scope: SCOPE OF THE VALUE HOLD-OUT (⛔ quote no row without this). The hold-out is from the STORE'S FIT POOL, not from the encoder, the decoder or the judge. Those three are frozen, hash-pinned and read-only (charter §A.4) and were fitted on a train split containing EVERY hue and EVERY shape; re-fitting them on a value hold-out would void every wave-2 number and is out of scope. Therefore 'never trained on' means here: THE STORE NEVER HELD A ROW CARRYING THAT VALUE. The decoder can still render the value and the judge can still recognise it — which is what makes rows 2/5/6/7 scorable at all. ⛔ Read end-to-end, 'never seen' is false and the claim dies with it.

verdict.verdict: ⛔ A CLU mechanism that ties basis+head is decoration and is reported as such, in those words.
